items.reason: Safe-state claim that is correct: GET and POST /benefits are wired with isLoggedIn and isAdmin (app/routes/index.js:55-56); anonymous callers are redirected by isLoggedInMiddleware (app/routes/session.js:36-42) and non-admins by isAdminUserMiddleware (app/routes/session.js:25-34), while an admin reaches displayBenefits. This is AC-1, CLOSED in the ground truth. No defect asserted.

Behavior is true (app/routes/session.js:28 and :32 redirect to /login instead of 403), but the ground truth classes this as AC-2, CLOSED (OVER-RATED, informational): nothing relevant is disclosed. Not a defect per the ground truth's own call.

app/routes/allocations.js:16-18 takes userId from req.params (the session-based fix is commented at :12-15) and passes it to the DAO at :23; the route has only isLoggedIn (app/routes/index.js:59); the DAO filters by that id (app/data/allocations-dao.js:58, :81-83) and adds firstName/lastName (:97-99), which app/views/allocations.html:35-46 renders with stocks/funds/bonds. Ids are sequential (app/data/user-dao.js:38-44, :109-120). IDOR as stated.

app/data/allocations-dao.js:77-79 builds $where with threshold spliced inside quotes (`this.stocks > '${threshold}'`), so a value such as 1'; return 1 == '1 makes the predicate true for every record; the DAO then returns all matched allocations (:86-108) and the view renders each (app/views/allocations.html:32-49). Taking userId from the session would not change this. Matches ADJ-1.

Correct description of a non-defect: memos are stored with only memo and timestamp (app/data/memos-dao.js:18-21) and read globally (:28); the ground truth lists this as a candidate examined and not included (shared board by design, no per-user data).

Safe-state claim that is correct: bodyParser.json (server.js:71) lets userName be an operator object that findOne uses (app/data/user-dao.js:91-93), but comparePassword uses strict equality (app/data/user-dao.js:61, :75), so without the selected user's actual password the login fails. No bypass asserted.

Safe-state claim that is correct: Express 4 routing is case-insensitive and non-strict by default and serves HEAD through GET routes, so all listed variants hit app/routes/index.js:55-56 with isAdmin; JSON bodies go through the same route; no method-override or other route registration exists (grep of app.get/post/use); BenefitsDAO is used only in app/routes/benefits.js:2-11.

app/routes/session.js:116 sets req.session.userId on the existing session without req.session.regenerate (the fix is only a comment at :104-115), whereas signup regenerates (app/routes/session.js:234); with saveUninitialized: true (server.js:84) a pre-login id is issued and stays valid after login. This is the GT-2 session-fixation mechanism; the hedge about planting the id does not change that the stated behavior is the defect.

app/routes/session.js:85 renders "Invalid username" for noSuchUser and :94 renders "Invalid password" for invalidPassword (messages defined at :60-61); the uniform message is only a comment. User enumeration, part of ADJ-9.

server.js:78-102 passes no cookie options (maxAge is only a TODO in the comment at :94), and no store is set, so the default MemoryStore keeps sessions with no expiry and there is no idle or absolute timeout. ADJ-3 lists no maxAge / no expiry.

Safe-state claim that is correct: app/routes/profile.js:14-16 and :78-80, app/routes/contributions.js:13-15 and :42-44 take userId from req.session; the DAOs filter on it (app/data/profile-dao.js:78-79, :95-96; app/data/contributions-dao.js:28-29, :57-58). Ground truth lists this among checks not listed as defects.

Safe-state claim that is correct: app/routes/index.js:30 and :44 route / and /dashboard to displayWelcomePage, which redirects when req.session.userId is missing (app/routes/session.js:259-262) and loads only req.session.userId (:264-266).

Safe-state claim that is correct: addUser builds the document field by field with no isAdmin (app/data/user-dao.js:20-36) and handleSignup passes only named fields (app/routes/session.js:191-198, :220). Ground truth: no mass assignment to isAdmin.

Safe-state claim that is correct: isLoggedIn is on /dashboard, /profile, /contributions, /allocations/:userId, /memos, /learn and /research (app/routes/index.js:44-72) and checks req.session.userId, redirecting to /login otherwise (app/routes/session.js:36-42).

Safe-state claim that is correct: /tutorial is mounted without middleware (app/routes/index.js:75) and its handlers pass only environmentalScripts (app/routes/tutorial.js:8-37); the error page renders only the error object (app/views/error-template.html:11, app/routes/error.js:9-12). Ground truth: public by design.

Safe-state claim that is correct: handleProfileUpdate destructures seven named fields (app/routes/profile.js:42-50) and updateUser builds $set only from them (app/data/profile-dao.js:45-66, :78-82). Ground truth: no mass assignment.

Safe-state claim that is correct: isAdminUserMiddleware calls getUserById on each request (app/routes/session.js:27, app/data/user-dao.js:97-101) and passes only if user && user.isAdmin (:28), so an error or missing user redirects. Ground truth lists this as fail-closed.

server.js:145 starts a plain http server (HTTPS commented at :149-155); no cookie options are set (server.js:78-102), so the express-session default cookie is HttpOnly but not Secure (per the ground truth correction). The session id travels in clear text and can be intercepted. Matches ADJ-4 (also touches ADJ-3, no secure).
app/data/user-dao.js:25 stores the password as received (bcrypt only in the comment at :26-30) and :61 compares fromDB === fromUser. Part of ADJ-9.
app/routes/contributions.js:32-34 eval req.body.preTax/afterTax/roth; the route needs only isLoggedIn (app/routes/index.js:52). SSJS injection, ADJ-8.
app/routes/research.js:15 builds url = req.query.url + req.query.symbol and :16 fetches it with needle.get. SSRF, ADJ-7.
app/routes/index.js:68 does res.redirect(req.query.url) with no check. Open redirect, ADJ-6.

app/routes/profile.js:59 uses /([0-9]+)+\#/ (nested quantifier) and :61 tests it against req.body.bankRouting; a long digit string without # triggers catastrophic backtracking in the backtracking regex engine (the fix /([0-9]+)\#/ is in the comment at :58). Not in the ground truth.

app/routes/session.js:64 logs the raw submitted userName with console.log; the encoding/CRLF fix is only in the comment at :66-80, so newline characters forge log lines (log injection). Not in the ground truth.

csurf is commented out (server.js:7, :104-113, app.use(csrf()) at :107), no SameSite is set on the session cookie (server.js:78-102), and POST /benefits accepts userId and benefitStartDate from the body (app/routes/benefits.js:30-35); an admin's browser can be made to submit it with the admin session, passing isAdmin. Matches ADJ-2.
server.js:135-142 calls swig.setDefaults({ autoescape: false }) (line 137); consolidate.swig (server.js:116) renders with these defaults. Matches ADJ-5.

Safe-state claim that is correct: app/routes/index.js:55-56 put isAdmin before displayBenefits and updateBenefits, and isAdminUserMiddleware redirects non-admins (app/routes/session.js:25-34) before app/data/benefits-dao.js:23-40 is reached, for any body encoding. This is AC-1, CLOSED.
Behavior is true (app/routes/session.js:28, :32), but the ground truth classes it as AC-2, CLOSED (OVER-RATED, informational). Not a defect per the ground truth's own call.

app/routes/allocations.js:16-18 takes userId from req.params, route guarded only by isLoggedIn (app/routes/index.js:59); DAO filters by it (app/data/allocations-dao.js:58, :81-83) and adds names (:97-99) rendered at app/views/allocations.html:35-46. Signup is open (app/routes/index.js:37-38) and sets the session (app/routes/session.js:234-235); ids are sequential (app/data/user-dao.js:38-44, :109-120). IDOR as stated.

Correct description of a non-defect: memos have only memo and timestamp (app/data/memos-dao.js:18-21), all are listed (:28), and only GET/POST /memos exist (app/routes/index.js:62-63), with no edit/delete. Ground truth: candidate examined and not included.

Safe-state claim that is correct: updateUser sets only firstName, lastName, address, bankAcc, bankRouting, ssn, dob (app/data/profile-dao.js:45-66) filtered by the session id (app/routes/profile.js:78-83); isAdmin/_id/userId in the body are ignored (app/routes/profile.js:42-50).
Safe-state claim that is correct: app/data/user-dao.js:20-36 builds the user document from named fields only; no isAdmin. Ground truth: no mass assignment.

Safe-state claim that is correct: Express 4 defaults (case-insensitive, non-strict, HEAD served by GET routes, query ignored) map all variants to app/routes/index.js:55-56 with isAdmin; no method-override middleware is registered (server.js:68-132, grep finds none).

Correct fail-closed description: the callback at app/routes/session.js:27-29 ignores err but passes only if user && user.isAdmin, so a lookup error redirects. Ground truth lists this as a check, not a defect.

Safe-state claim that is correct: app/routes/profile.js:14-16, :78-80 and app/routes/contributions.js:13-15, :42-44 use req.session.userId; DAOs filter on it (app/data/profile-dao.js:78-79, :95-96; app/data/contributions-dao.js:28-29, :57-58).

app/data/allocations-dao.js:77-79 splices threshold into a $where string, so an injected expression returns every allocation (:86-108), rendered by app/views/allocations.html:32-49; works from the caller's own /allocations page and independently of where userId comes from. ADJ-1.

test/e2e/integration/benefits_access_guard_spec.js:17-21 only signs in a non-admin and visits GET /benefits; no test posts to /benefits. Removing isAdmin from app/routes/index.js:56 would let non-admins reach updateBenefits (app/routes/benefits.js:29-35) with this guard still passing. A coverage gap in the AC-1 regression guard (test code, not in the ground truth).

test/e2e/integration/benefits_access_guard_spec.js:18-20 never asserts that cy.userSignIn succeeded (test/e2e/support/commands.js:4-9, :18-23 only type and click); a failed login stays on /login and an anonymous visit to /benefits is redirected by isLoggedIn (app/routes/session.js:36-42), so the assertion url includes login passes without the isAdmin check being exercised. Test robustness defect, not in the ground truth.
Safe-state claim that is correct: app/routes/session.js:259-266 checks the session and loads only req.session.userId for / and /dashboard (app/routes/index.js:30, :44).
Safe-state claim that is correct: isLoggedIn wired at app/routes/index.js:44-72 for all listed routes; it checks req.session.userId (app/routes/session.js:36-42).

Safe-state claim that is correct: app/routes/index.js:75 mounts the tutorial router with no middleware; app/routes/tutorial.js:8-37 renders static templates with only environmentalScripts. Ground truth: public on purpose.

Safe-state claim that is correct: express.static serves app/assets without auth (server.js:121), and app/assets holds only favicon.ico, images/, js/ and vendor/; no file or directory matches benefits, dashboard, profile, contributions, allocations, memos, learn or research.

Asserts no defect: it states the secret was not assessed and that express-session keeps data server side (no store set at server.js:78-102, so MemoryStore) and signs only the id, which is correct. The hardcoded cookieSecret (config/env/all.js:8) is part of ADJ-3, but this claim does not assert it.

Facts are true: test/e2e/integration/allocations_spec.js:20-21, :26-27, :33-34 sign in user1 (_id 2, artifacts/db-reset.js:22-23) and visit /allocations/1 (admin, _id 1), and :45 expects /allocations/1, so a GT-1 fix would require updating these tests. That is a consequence of GT-1 and normal test maintenance, not a defect of its own; the tests still check what they are written to check (stricter reading).
app/routes/contributions.js:32-34 eval req.body.preTax, afterTax and roth; route requires only isLoggedIn (app/routes/index.js:52). ADJ-8.
app/routes/research.js:15-16 builds the URL from req.query.url + req.query.symbol and calls needle.get on it. ADJ-7.
app/routes/index.js:68 redirects to req.query.url unchecked. ADJ-6.

True that a JSON body (server.js:71) can put an operator object into findOne at app/data/user-dao.js:91-93, but the claim itself says the strict-equality password check (app/data/user-dao.js:61, :75) limits the effect and states no concrete harm; no login bypass results. Not asserted as a defect with an effect (stricter reading).
app/routes/session.js:116 assigns userId to the existing session with no req.session.regenerate (only a comment at :104-115), unlike signup (:234). This is the GT-2 session-fixation mechanism.

csurf is commented out (server.js:104-113, line 107), no SameSite is configured (server.js:78-102), and POST /benefits takes userId and benefitStartDate from the body (app/routes/benefits.js:30-35), so a cross-site form submitted from an admin's browser passes isAdmin. ADJ-2.

server.js:92-100 comments out cookie: { httpOnly: true, secure: true } (and maxAge is a TODO). Per the ground truth correction httpOnly is already the express-session default, but Secure is not set, so the cookie is sent over HTTP. Decided on the missing Secure flag; ADJ-3.
server.js:135-142 sets swig autoescape: false (line 137). ADJ-5.

Memos are stored as submitted (app/routes/memos.js:13, app/data/memos-dao.js:18-23) and rendered for every signed-in user, admin included, through marked 0.3.5 (package.json:17) at app/views/memos.html:31 with autoescape off (server.js:137); marked 0.3.5 sanitize can be bypassed with a javascript: link (app/views/tutorial/a9.html:139-163). Stored XSS in memos, which the ground truth places under ADJ-5. Execution needs the viewer to click the planted link, so 'runs for every viewer' is overstated; decided on the stored-XSS part.
app/data/user-dao.js:25 stores the password as received; hashing is only in the comment at :26-30. ADJ-9.
app/data/profile-dao.js:61-63 sets user.ssn = ssn as submitted and :78-82 writes it; the encryption is only in comments (:15-40, :67-76). Sensitive data stored in clear; not in the ground truth.

app/routes/profile.js:59 defines /([0-9]+)+\#/ and :61 tests req.body.bankRouting with it; nested quantifier with a required suffix backtracks exponentially on digit strings without #. Not in the ground truth.
app/routes/session.js:85 (Invalid username) and :94 (Invalid password) distinguish the two cases, revealing which usernames exist. ADJ-9.

In AllocationsDAO.update the success branch starts getUserById, whose callback calls callback at app/data/allocations-dao.js:41 or :49, but the if (!err) block does not return, so :53 return callback(err, null) also runs; on success the callback fires twice (null,null then the result or an error). A correctness bug with low impact (caller at app/routes/session.js:20-22 only acts on errors); not access control, not in the ground truth.

notes: A-2 and B-2: the behavior is true, but graded NOT REAL because the ground truth closes it as AC-2, OVER-RATED and informational.

A-8 (unconfirmed, hedges on whether an id can be planted) and B-23 (states only that the session is not regenerated) are both graded REAL as GT-2: each states the defect mechanism at app/routes/session.js:116.
A-10: without maxAge the cookie is a browser-session cookie, but the server-side MemoryStore session never expires. Graded REAL under ADJ-3, which the ground truth describes as 'no expiry'.
A-18: given ADJ-4 (plain HTTP, the cited server.js:145). The missing Secure flag also falls under ADJ-3.
B-25: per the ground truth correction httpOnly is on by default, so only the missing Secure flag (and maxAge) is a defect. Graded REAL under ADJ-3 on that part.

B-27 (borderline): marked 0.3.5 with sanitize escapes raw HTML, so the documented vector is a javascript: link that runs only when clicked, not on every page view. Graded REAL under ADJ-5 on the stored-XSS part, with 'every user who views' noted as overstated.
A-25 and B-24: no SameSite is set. Browsers that default to Lax would block most cross-site POSTs, but static analysis follows ADJ-2.

B-11 and B-12 (borderline): defects in the AC-1 guard test, not in the application. Graded REAL, outside GT, and out of zone because test code is not part of the ground truth zone. B-12 is the weaker of the two: it only matters if the non-admin sign-in fails.
B-18 (borderline): the facts are true, but on the stricter reading it is NOT REAL. Tests that would need updating with a GT-1 fix are a consequence of GT-1, not a separate defect.

B-22 (borderline): the login query does accept a NoSQL operator, but the claim names no harmful effect and itself says strict equality limits it. NOT REAL on the stricter reading. A possible username extraction through $regex combined with the distinct error messages is not claimed.
A-6 and B-22 in_zone set to no: login injection and authentication weaknesses map to the ground truth's adjacent classes (ADJ-1 injection, ADJ-9 authentication), not to the access-control main list.
B-16 in_zone yes (whether protected routes can be reached through static files); B-17 in_zone no (session secret, ADJ-3 territory, and no defect asserted).

A-23/B-30 (ReDoS), A-24 (log injection), B-29 (plaintext SSN) and B-32 (double callback) are real defects outside the ground truth and outside the zone. B-32 is low impact but is a real contract violation.
